props.description: When you cast an 【⚡Offensive Spell】, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you gain a bonus to your Magic Check equal to 【SL × 2】
props.name: Magical Artillery
props.passive_logic_action:
const TAG = "[PASSIVE][MagicalArtillery][Action]";

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const isAutoPassiveExecution =

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.isPassiveExecution === true ||

__PAYLOAD?.isPassiveExecution === true ||

norm(__PAYLOAD?.meta?.executionMode) === "autopassive" ||

norm(__PAYLOAD?.executionMode) === "autopassive";

const skipHidden = (reason = "") => {

__PAYLOAD.meta = __PAYLOAD.meta || {};

__PAYLOAD.meta.hidePassiveCard = true;

return context.skipPassive(reason, { notify: false });

};

// Important:

// This passive should modify the ORIGINAL spell action payload,

// not the later standalone auto-passive self execution.

if (isAutoPassiveExecution) {

return skipHidden("");

}

const passiveOwner =

__PASSIVE_ACTOR ??

context.passiveOwner ??

null;

const passiveItem =

__PASSIVE_ITEM ??

context.passiveItem ??

null;

if (!passiveOwner || !passiveItem) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 1) Check action type = Offensive Spell

// --------------------------------------------------

const listType = norm(

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.listType ??

__PAYLOAD?.listType ??

""

);

const detectedActionType = norm(

context.helpers?.getDetectedActionType?.() ?? ""

);

const actionTypeDebug =

context.helpers?.getActionTypeDebug?.() ?? {};

const isSpellish =

detectedActionType === "spell" ||

actionTypeDebug?.isSpell === true ||

__PAYLOAD?.meta?.isSpellish === true ||

__PAYLOAD?.dataCore?.isSpell === true;

const isOffensiveSpell = listType === "offensive spell";

if (!isSpellish || !isOffensiveSpell) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2) Manual equipped Arcane weapon check

// Avoid the missing helper on your current runtime build.

// --------------------------------------------------

const toBool = (v) =>

v === true || v === "true" || v === 1 || v === "1";

const getProps = (item) =>

item?.system?.props ?? item?.system ?? {};

const normCategory = (v) => {

const s = norm(v);

const aliases = {

arcana: "arcane",

arcane: "arcane",

wand: "arcane",

staff: "arcane",

tome: "arcane"

};

return aliases[s] ?? s;

};

const equippedWeapons = Array.from(passiveOwner?.items ?? []).filter((item) => {

const p = getProps(item);

const isEquipped = [

p?.isEquipped,

p?.equipped,

item?.system?.equipped,

item?.equipped,

item?.isEquipped

].some(toBool);

const itemType = norm(

p?.item_type ??

item?.system?.item_type ??

item?.type ??

""

);

return isEquipped && itemType === "weapon";

});

const hasArcaneWeapon = equippedWeapons.some((item) => {

const p = getProps(item);

const cat = normCategory(

p?.category ??

item?.system?.category ??

item?.category ??

""

);

return cat === "arcane";

});

if (!hasArcaneWeapon) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3) Skill level

// --------------------------------------------------

const skillLevel = Math.max(

0,

Number(

passiveItem?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.active_level ??

passiveItem?.system?.props?.passive_level ??

0

) || 0

);

const bonusToAdd = skillLevel * 2;

if (bonusToAdd <= 0) {

return skipHidden("");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 4) Apply bonus to Magic Check

// Update BOTH checkBonus and total.

// --------------------------------------------------

__PAYLOAD.accuracy = __PAYLOAD.accuracy || {};

const beforeCheckBonus = Number(__PAYLOAD?.accuracy?.checkBonus ?? 0) || 0;

const beforeBonusField = Number(__PAYLOAD?.accuracy?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const beforeTotalRaw = Number(__PAYLOAD?.accuracy?.total ?? NaN);

const beforeTotal = Number.isFinite(beforeTotalRaw) ? beforeTotalRaw : null;

// If this spell somehow has no accuracy object, quietly do nothing.

if (beforeTotal === null) {

return skipHidden("");

}

__PAYLOAD.accuracy.checkBonus = beforeCheckBonus + bonusToAdd;

__PAYLOAD.accuracy.bonus = beforeBonusField + bonusToAdd;

__PAYLOAD.accuracy.total = beforeTotal + bonusToAdd;

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5) Debug

// --------------------------------------------------

__PAYLOAD.meta = __PAYLOAD.meta || {};

__PAYLOAD.meta.magicalArtilleryDebug = {

passiveOwner: passiveOwner?.name ?? null,

passiveItem: passiveItem?.name ?? null,

listType,

detectedActionType,

isSpellish,

isOffensiveSpell,

hasArcaneWeapon,

equippedWeapons: equippedWeapons.map((w) => ({

name: w?.name ?? null,

category: normCategory(

getProps(w)?.category ??

w?.system?.category ??

w?.category ??

""

)

})),

skillLevel,

bonusAdded: bonusToAdd,

checkBonusBefore: beforeCheckBonus,

checkBonusAfter: __PAYLOAD.accuracy.checkBonus,

totalBefore: beforeTotal,

totalAfter: __PAYLOAD.accuracy.total

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", __PAYLOAD.meta.magicalArtilleryDebug);

context.log("Magical Artillery applied", __PAYLOAD.meta.magicalArtilleryDebug);
